dimensions.title: Dimension Analysis
dimensions.subtitle: Detailed breakdown of risk levels and gap scores by dimension
dimensions.popoverDesc: This table provides a detailed breakdown of risk distribution for each dimension across all submissions. It helps in identifying which areas of your organization are most exposed to digital risks.
dimensions.highRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as high risk. High-risk areas require immediate attention.
dimensions.mediumRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as medium risk. These areas should be monitored.
dimensions.lowRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as low risk. These are areas of strength.

high.title: Highest Risk Dimension & Recommendations
high.subtitle: Priority focus area requiring immediate attention
high.popover: This dimension has the highest average risk score across all submissions. It represents the most critical area requiring immediate action.

medium.title: Dimension Needing Attention & Recommendations
medium.subtitle: This dimension has a moderate gap — worth monitoring and improving
medium.popover: This dimension has a moderate average risk score. It is not critical but should be monitored and improved over time.

low.title: Dimension with Most Room to Improve
low.subtitle: All dimensions are performing well. This one has the most potential for further growth
low.popover: All dimensions are at low risk. This dimension has the highest score among them, meaning it has the most room for further improvement — not that it is at risk.
low.recTitle: Suggestions to Further Strengthen This Dimension

focus.aboutDesc: The recommendations below are tailored to this dimension and can be incorporated into your action plan.

chart.title: Dominant Risk level by Dimension
chart.subtitle: Percentage of dominant risk level per dimension
chart.aboutDesc1: This bar chart visualizes the most dominant risk level (High, Medium, or Low) for each dimension. The dominant risk is the risk level with the highest percentage of submissions for that dimension.
chart.aboutDesc2: This provides a quick overview of the general risk profile of each dimension, helping you to easily spot which dimensions are consistently ranked as high-risk.
